name: Spiced Pork, Apple, Celery & Cranberry Stuffed Acorn Squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F) and place rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 acorn squash
3 Gala apples
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Halve each acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core apples, then medium dice; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the veggies and apple.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¾ tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, add broth, cranberries, and sugar; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup dried cranberries
2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the pork and veggie stuffing. Enjoy!
